name: Pressure Skewer
additional_info: While active, the following buffs are applied to Rapier light attacks and criticals with the M1 tag: increases blood loss by 50%, grants +25% chip damage, and +3 true damage.
desc: [Rapier] Flourishing an enemy causes your M1's to deal additional chip damage, blood loss and makes your hits deal 3 extra true damage until you take damage.
